description: Product Search - Add search functionality to the shop frontend

userStories.title: Add search API endpoint
userStories.description: Create API endpoint to search products by name (EN/KH) and description
acceptanceCriteria: Accept query parameter 'q' for search term
Search in nameEn, nameKh, descriptionEn, descriptionKh fields
Return matching products with category info

userStories.title: Add search input component to shop header
userStories.description: Add a search input field in the shop header for customers to search products
acceptanceCriteria: Add search input to shop header (components/shop-header.tsx or similar)
Use Shadcn Input component with Search icon
Responsive: full width on mobile, fixed width on desktop
Placeholder text: 'Search products...' (EN) / 'ស្វែងរកផលិតផល...' (KH)
userStories.notes: Search input added to components/header.tsx with Shadcn Input + Search icon

userStories.title: Implement search results dropdown
userStories.description: Show search results in a dropdown as user types
acceptanceCriteria: Show dropdown with matching products below search input
Display product image, name, and price in results
Show 'No results found' message when no matches
userStories.notes: SearchDropdown component with 300ms debounce, skeleton loading, bilingual no results message

userStories.title: Add search result click navigation
userStories.description: Navigate to product detail page when clicking a search result
acceptanceCriteria: Click on search result navigates to /shop/product/[id]
Keyboard navigation: Enter to select highlighted result
userStories.notes: Click navigates to /shop/product/[id], keyboard nav with Arrow Up/Down and Enter, Escape to close

userStories.title: Add search to translations
userStories.description: Add bilingual support for search UI text
userStories.notes: Added search translations (placeholder, noResults, searching, viewAll) to lib/i18n.ts for EN/KH. Updated header.tsx and search-dropdown.tsx to use translations.

userStories.title: Add search API security features
userStories.description: Implement security measures for the search API endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: Add input validation: max query length (100 chars)
Sanitize search input to prevent XSS in results
userStories.notes: Implemented input validation (100 char max), XSS sanitization, in-memory rate limiting (60 req/min), 400 responses for invalid queries, suspicious pattern logging

userStories.title: Add whitelabel product filtering
userStories.description: Filter search results to only show active products visible to customers
acceptanceCriteria: Only return products where isActive = true
Only return products where isVisible = true (if field exists)
Filter by shopId/tenantId if multi-tenant (from settings)
Exclude out-of-stock products option via query param 'inStock=true'
userStories.notes: Implemented: isActive=true (already present), inStock=true param filters by inventory.quantity > 0, includes inventory data in response. Single-tenant system so no shopId filtering needed. isVisible field doesn't exist in schema.

userStories.title: Add search result branding support
userStories.description: Support whitelabel branding in search results display
acceptanceCriteria: Use shop's primary color for search highlight
Support custom 'no results' message from shop settings
Apply shop's font settings to search dropdown
userStories.notes: Implemented SearchBranding interface with primaryColor/accentColor/borderRadius/customNoResultsMessage. Keyboard-highlighted items use shop primary color. Dropdown inherits parent font via CSS cascade. Currency already respected via currency prop.

userStories.title: Add search analytics tracking
userStories.description: Track search queries for shop analytics and security monitoring
acceptanceCriteria: Log search queries to database (SearchLog model)
Add API endpoint GET /api/analytics/search for admin
Show popular searches in admin dashboard
userStories.notes: Implemented SearchLog model, logging in search API, analytics endpoint with popular/zero-result queries, and PopularSearchesWidget in dashboard

userStories.title: Dynamic component registry system
userStories.description: Create a registry for dynamic shop components that can be enabled/disabled per client
acceptanceCriteria: Create ComponentRegistry type with id, name, component, defaultEnabled fields
Support lazy loading components with React.lazy()
Add enable/disable toggle in admin settings

userStories.title: Dynamic page builder blocks
userStories.description: Add draggable content blocks for the shop page builder
acceptanceCriteria: Create block types: Hero, ProductGrid, Banner, Testimonials, Features, FAQ
Each block has configurable props (title, images, products, etc.)
Blocks can be reordered via drag-and-drop
userStories.notes: Extends existing customizer with more block types

userStories.title: Admin sales report dashboard
userStories.description: Create comprehensive sales reporting for admin dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Create GET /api/reports/sales endpoint with date range filter
Add chart visualization (use Recharts or similar)
userStories.notes: Key admin feature for business insights

userStories.title: Admin customer analytics report
userStories.description: Track and display customer behavior analytics
acceptanceCriteria: Show customer growth chart over time
Display top customers by order value

userStories.title: Admin inventory report
userStories.description: Inventory status and low stock alerts report
acceptanceCriteria: Configurable low stock threshold per product

userStories.title: Multi-tenant client model
userStories.description: Database schema and API support for multiple shop clients
acceptanceCriteria: Add Client model to Prisma: id, name, domain, settings, createdAt
Add clientId foreign key to Product, Order, Customer models
Middleware to inject clientId from domain/subdomain

userStories.title: Client-specific theming
userStories.description: Each client can have custom theme colors and branding
acceptanceCriteria: Add theme fields to Client model: primaryColor, secondaryColor, logo, favicon
Create useClientTheme() hook to apply theme CSS variables
Theme applies to all shop pages automatically
Preview theme in admin before saving

userStories.title: Client domain routing
userStories.description: Route requests to correct client based on domain/subdomain
acceptanceCriteria: Create middleware to detect client from request hostname
Store client context in request for API routes
Fallback to default client if domain not found

userStories.title: Recently viewed products
userStories.description: Track and display recently viewed products for better UX
acceptanceCriteria: Store recently viewed product IDs in localStorage (max 10)
Create RecentlyViewed component showing product cards
Display on product detail page and homepage

userStories.title: Product recommendations
userStories.description: Show related products based on category and purchase history
acceptanceCriteria: Return products from same category, excluding current product
Optional: Use order history for 'customers also bought' logic

userStories.title: Wishlist functionality
userStories.description: Allow customers to save products to a wishlist
acceptanceCriteria: Add Wishlist model: id, customerId, productId, createdAt
Add heart icon button on product cards
Create wishlist page showing saved products
Persist in localStorage for guests, database for logged-in users

userStories.title: Product quick view modal
userStories.description: Quick view popup without navigating to product page
acceptanceCriteria: Show product image, name, price, description, add to cart button
Open via 'Quick View' button on product card hover

userStories.title: Advanced product filtering
userStories.description: Filter products by price range, category, and attributes
acceptanceCriteria: Create FilterSidebar component with collapsible sections
Sort options: price low-high, high-low, newest, popular
URL query params sync for shareable filtered views
userStories.notes: Essential for shops with many products

userStories.title: Product reviews and ratings
userStories.description: Customer reviews with star ratings for products
acceptanceCriteria: Add Review model: id, productId, customerId, rating (1-5), comment, createdAt
Display average rating on product cards
Show review list on product detail page

userStories.title: Order status notifications
userStories.description: Notify customers of order status changes
acceptanceCriteria: Create notification service for order updates
Support email notifications (optional, if SMTP configured)
userStories.notes: Keeps customers informed about their orders

userStories.title: Admin dashboard widgets
userStories.description: Customizable dashboard with draggable widget cards
acceptanceCriteria: Create widget types: SalesOverview, RecentOrders, LowStock, TopProducts
Save widget layout preference per admin user

userStories.title: Bulk product import/export
userStories.description: Import and export products via CSV/Excel files
acceptanceCriteria: Support fields: name, price, stock, category, description, images
Validation with error report for failed rows
userStories.notes: Essential for shops with large catalogs

userStories.title: Super admin client management
userStories.description: Super admin panel to manage all clients/tenants
acceptanceCriteria: List all clients with search and pagination
View client statistics: orders, revenue, products count

userStories.title: Client subscription/billing model
userStories.description: Subscription tiers for multi-tenant SaaS billing
acceptanceCriteria: Add Subscription model: clientId, plan (free/starter/pro), status, expiresAt
Define plan limits: products, orders/month, features
Create GET /api/subscription endpoint for current plan
Show upgrade prompts when approaching limits

userStories.title: Audit log for admin actions
userStories.description: Track all admin actions for security and compliance
acceptanceCriteria: Add AuditLog model: userId, action, resource, details, timestamp, ipAddress
Display audit log in admin settings page
Filter by date range, user, action type

userStories.title: PWA offline support
userStories.description: Progressive Web App features for offline access
acceptanceCriteria: Add manifest.json with app icons and theme color
Create service worker for caching static assets
Add to Home Screen prompt on mobile
userStories.notes: Improved mobile UX, especially in Cambodia with spotty internet

userStories.title: JWT token authentication
userStories.description: Replace session-based auth with JWT tokens for better scalability
acceptanceCriteria: Generate JWT access token (15min expiry) and refresh token (7 days)
Store refresh token in httpOnly cookie
Add JWT verification middleware for protected routes
Include user role and permissions in token payload
userStories.notes: Stateless auth for better horizontal scaling

userStories.title: Role-based access control (RBAC)
userStories.description: Granular permissions system for admin users
acceptanceCriteria: Define roles: super_admin, admin, manager, staff
Create Permission model: id, name, description
Add middleware to check permissions on API routes
Create admin UI to manage role permissions
userStories.notes: Fine-grained access control for enterprise clients

userStories.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
userStories.description: Optional 2FA for admin accounts using TOTP
acceptanceCriteria: Add twoFactorSecret and twoFactorEnabled to User model
Create POST /api/auth/2fa/setup endpoint returning QR code
Prompt for 2FA code on login if enabled

userStories.title: Password security enhancements
userStories.description: Stronger password policies and secure handling
acceptanceCriteria: Minimum 8 chars, require uppercase, lowercase, number, special char
Use bcrypt with cost factor 12 for hashing
Prevent reuse of last 5 passwords (store password history)
Real-time password strength indicator on forms

userStories.title: Account lockout protection
userStories.description: Prevent brute force attacks with account lockout
acceptanceCriteria: Lock account after 5 failed login attempts
Track failed attempts with IP address

userStories.title: Session management
userStories.description: Track and manage active user sessions
acceptanceCriteria: Add Session model: userId, token, device, ipAddress, lastActive, createdAt
Show active sessions in user profile
Allow user to revoke individual sessions

userStories.title: Security headers middleware
userStories.description: Add security headers to all responses
userStories.notes: Defense in depth against common attacks

userStories.title: CSRF protection
userStories.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery protection for forms
acceptanceCriteria: Include token in all state-changing forms
userStories.notes: Prevents unauthorized actions from malicious sites

userStories.title: API key authentication
userStories.description: API keys for third-party integrations
acceptanceCriteria: Add ApiKey model: id, clientId, key (hashed), name, scopes, expiresAt
Create POST /api/keys endpoint to generate keys

userStories.title: OAuth2 social login
userStories.description: Login with Google and Facebook for customers
acceptanceCriteria: Link social accounts to existing email accounts
Create account if email doesn't exist
Store provider tokens for future use

userStories.title: Password reset flow
userStories.description: Secure password reset via email
acceptanceCriteria: Rate limit reset requests (3 per hour per email)

userStories.title: Email verification
userStories.description: Verify customer email addresses
acceptanceCriteria: Add emailVerified and emailVerifyToken to User/Customer model
Restrict certain actions until email verified

userStories.title: Login activity notifications
userStories.description: Alert users of new login activity
acceptanceCriteria: Send email on login from new device/location
Include device info, IP, location, timestamp
Option to mark as 'not me' to trigger security review

userStories.title: IP whitelisting for admin
userStories.description: Restrict admin access to specific IP addresses
acceptanceCriteria: Add allowedIPs field to User model (for admins)
Middleware to check IP on admin routes
Support CIDR notation for IP ranges
Super admin can bypass IP restrictions

userStories.title: Security event logging
userStories.description: Comprehensive security event audit trail
acceptanceCriteria: Add SecurityLog model: event, userId, ipAddress, userAgent, details, timestamp
Log: logins, failed logins, password changes, 2FA events, permission changes

userStories.title: Data encryption at rest
userStories.description: Encrypt sensitive data in database
acceptanceCriteria: Encrypt PII fields: phone, address, payment details
Use AES-256 encryption with key from env variable
userStories.notes: Protects data if database is compromised

userStories.title: API rate limiting
userStories.description: Global rate limiting for all API endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Default limit: 100 requests per minute per IP
Return 429 with Retry-After header when exceeded
Redis-based rate limiting for distributed deployments

userStories.title: Input validation middleware
userStories.description: Centralized request validation using Zod
acceptanceCriteria: Create validation schemas for all API endpoints
Validate request body, query params, and path params
Sanitize string inputs to prevent XSS
Type-safe validated data in route handlers
userStories.notes: Prevents injection attacks and invalid data

userStories.title: Secure file upload
userStories.description: Security measures for file uploads
acceptanceCriteria: Validate file type by magic bytes (not just extension)
Max file size limit (5MB default, configurable)
Store files with random UUID names
Serve files through signed URLs with expiry

userStories.title: Admin security dashboard
userStories.description: Real-time security monitoring dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Quick actions: force logout, lock account
